items.title: Tomorrowland Wizard
items.description: As someone who loves the Tomorrowland music festival, I felt like the official website was lacking in some ways. This app enables the user to view the lineup in a few different ways. You can press the artist name to play some of their music. There is also a price chart for the Tomorrowland NFT. Probably my most successful hobby project to date based on the feedback I got on Reddit
highlights: Puppeteer web scraper for lineup data

items.title: Kombucha Brewery
items.description: As I was brewing kombucha at home, I constantly kept loosing track of the dates I started a new batch. So I made this tracking application to track the progress and get email reminders when it's time to check on it.
highlights: Built with Next JS server components
OAuth using Clerk with Google sign-in

items.title: Portfolio website
items.description: This is the website you are browsing right now! I think terminal based GUIs look so cool so I wanted to go for something like that. This website is actually built completely by prompting AI. I wanted to test out how good modern AI is for coding and this was a perfect opportunity for it as I don't exactly love dabbling with HTML and CSS.
highlights: Mobile responsive with dark and light mode

items.title: Top XYZ
items.description:
Create a toplist for anything! Top XYZ is a SPA that helps you keep track of your personal favorites within any topic. You can rank them and share your toplists with others.

This website took me a long time to build as my goal was to build as much as possible from scratch for the purpose of learning.

It has a lot of features such as counting the toplist views and likes, it has its own username/pw based auth built with the bcrypt and jwt library. It has account management and functionality for resetting your password with your email. There is a file server for serving images from the server. There is also rate limiting to prevent ddos and many more features.
highlights: React frontend with a Go backend and a Postgres database

items.title: Lofi Chat
items.description: A TCP/IP terminal based chat application. This was a good opportunity to get more hands on experience with TCP/IP as well as object oriented programming with C# and multi-threaded applications.
highlights: Point system against violations for auto banning IP addresses

items.title: 1v1 Snake
items.description: A 1v1 snake game where each snake keeps growing. Be the last one alive as space keeps getting more and more limited. Idea comes from one of the first online games I played as a kid on a Swedish game site called Blip.se
